title.original: HiMem: Hierarchical Long-Term Memory for LLM Long-Horizon Agents
title.zh: HiMem：面向长时程 LLM 智能体的分层长期记忆
title.en: HiMem: Hierarchical Long-Term Memory for LLM Long-Horizon Agents

inclusion_reason.zh: HiMem 的 Episode/Note 层级、跨层检索和冲突再巩固构成可复用的自演化长期记忆运行时。
inclusion_reason.en: HiMem's Episode/Note hierarchy, cross-level retrieval, and conflict reconsolidation form a reusable self-evolving long-term memory runtime.

abstract.zh: HiMem 为长程对话构建层级长期记忆：Episode Memory 保存具体交互事件，Note Memory 提炼稳定知识，两者用语义边连接。系统还通过冲突感知的记忆再巩固，根据召回反馈修订和补充已有状态。
abstract.en: HiMem builds hierarchical long-term memory for extended dialogue: Episode Memory preserves interaction events, Note Memory extracts stable knowledge, and semantic links connect the two. Conflict-aware reconsolidation revises and supplements state from retrieval feedback.

problem.zh: 现有长期记忆在持续交互中难兼顾事件细节、稳定知识、检索效率和自我更新，旧事实与新信息冲突时尤其容易失真。
problem.en: Existing long-term memory struggles to preserve event detail, stable knowledge, retrieval efficiency, and self-update simultaneously, especially when new information conflicts with stored facts.

approach.zh: Topic-Aware Event–Surprise 双通道策略切分事件，多阶段抽取生成笔记；混合或 best-effort 检索跨两层取证，再巩固模块处理冲突与补充。
approach.en: Topic-aware event/surprise channels segment episodes, a multi-stage extractor creates notes, hybrid or best-effort retrieval traverses both levels, and reconsolidation handles conflict and supplementation.

system_design.zh: 写路径依次执行事件切分、Episode 存储、知识抽取和 Note 链接；读路径按需求在层间检索，反馈路径比较新旧事实并对相关节点执行再巩固。
system_design.en: The write path segments events, stores episodes, extracts notes, and links levels; the read path retrieves across the hierarchy, and a feedback path compares new and old evidence to reconsolidate affected nodes.

key_results.zh: 长程对话基准上，HiMem 被报告在准确率、一致性和长期推理方面持续优于代表性基线，同时保持有竞争力的效率。
key_results.en: On long-horizon dialogue benchmarks, HiMem is reported to outperform representative baselines in accuracy, consistency, and long-term reasoning while retaining favorable efficiency.

limitations.zh: 事件惊奇度、笔记抽取和冲突判断都依赖模型推断，错误可能在层级中累积；摘要未说明隐私删除、并发写入或超长期存储增长。
limitations.en: Surprise scoring, note extraction, and conflict detection are model-dependent and can compound errors across levels; privacy deletion, concurrent writes, and very-long-term growth are not described.

notes.zh: 长程对话、代表性基线及准确率/一致性/长期推理/效率维度来自官方摘要；模型、基准名、硬件和数值待全文审计。
notes.en: Long-horizon dialogue, representative baselines, and accuracy/consistency/reasoning/efficiency dimensions come from the official abstract; models, benchmark names, hardware, and values await full-text audit.
